content_sections.heading: Income Tax Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for Income Tax Recruitment 2026 through the Sports Quota must complete their online applications by 10 November 2026. The official Income Tax Delhi website confirms the revised application schedule.

content_sections.heading: Income Tax Department Vacancy 2026 - Post-Wise Details
content_sections.text: The Income Tax Department Recruitment 2026 notification announces 119 vacancies across three posts. The largest number of vacancies is for Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS), followed by Tax Assistant and Stenographer Grade II. Note: These vacancies are tentative and may be changed or reallocated according to departmental requirements. Under Income Tax MTS Recruitment 2026 , the Delhi Income Tax Department has announced 66 Multi-Tasking Staff vacancies for eligible meritorious sportspersons. Candidates must have passed Class 10 or an equivalent examination from a recognized board. The age limit is 18 to 25 years as on 31 August 2026, with applicable sports-quota relaxation. The MTS posts come under Pay Level 1, with a basic pay scale of Rs. 18,000 to Rs. 56,900. Eligible candidates can apply online through the official sports recruitment portal before 10 November 2026. The Income Tax Tax Assistant Vacancy 2026 includes 44 posts in the Delhi Region. Candidates must possess a Bachelor's Degree from a recognized university or an equivalent qualification. Selected candidates must also satisfy the prescribed Data Entry Speed requirement of 8,000 key depressions per hour in the applicable skill test. The age limit is 18 to 27 years as on 31 August 2026. Tax Assistant posts are classified under Pay Level 4, with a basic pay scale of Rs. 25,500 to Rs. 81,100. The Income Tax Stenographer Recruitment 2026 notification includes 9 Stenographer Grade II vacancies . Candidates should have passed Class 12 or an equivalent examination from a recognized board. Applicants must also meet the prescribed stenography skill requirements, including dictation at 80 words per minute for 10 minutes and transcription within the specified time. The age limit is 18 to 27 years, and the post carries Pay Level 4, with a basic pay scale of Rs. 25,500 to Rs. 81,100.

content_sections.heading: Income Tax Sports Quota Vacancy 2026 - Sports-Wise Details
content_sections.text: The Income Tax Delhi Sports Quota Recruitment 2026 includes vacancies across 27 sports disciplines , with 67 men's and 52 women's vacancies. Candidates must have recognized sports achievements in the notified events.

content_sections.heading: Income Tax Sports Quota Recruitment 2026 Eligibility
content_sections.text: Only eligible meritorious sportspersons who satisfy the prescribed educational and sports achievement conditions can apply for this recruitment. Candidates must also hold qualifying sports achievements recognized under the notification. Meeting the educational qualification alone does not make a candidate eligible for sports-quota recruitment. Applicants must have participated in or achieved the prescribed performance at recognized sports competitions during the period from 1 January 2020 to 15 October 2026 . Recognized sports achievements may include representation at international competitions, recognized national championships, inter-university competitions, national school games and specified Khelo India events, subject to the achievement criteria and order of preference in the official notification. Candidates must possess the required sports achievement certificates in the formats prescribed by the notification. Certificates issued by unauthorized authorities may not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Income Tax Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: The age limit for Income Tax Delhi Sports Quota Recruitment 2026 is calculated as on 31 August 2026 . Age Relaxation: Eligible meritorious sportspersons may receive upper-age relaxation of up to 5 years, or up to 10 years for eligible SC/ST candidates, according to the applicable government instructions and notification conditions.

content_sections.heading: Income Tax Department Salary 2026 - MTS, Tax Assistant and Stenographer
content_sections.text: The salary for Income Tax Department Sports Quota Recruitment 2026 depends on the post and pay level under the 7th Central Pay Commission. The amounts above represent the basic pay matrix ranges. Actual gross and take-home salary will depend on applicable allowances and deductions.

content_sections.heading: Income Tax Sports Quota Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The department will shortlist eligible candidates based on their sports achievements, qualifications and other notified eligibility conditions. Online Application Scrutiny Shortlisting Based on Sports Achievements and Eligibility Verification of Sports and Educational Certificates Applicable Skill or Other Assessments Final Selection and Appointment Formalities Preference is given to sports achievements in the order specified in the official notification. Candidates should not assume that educational qualifications alone guarantee selection.

content_sections.heading: Income Tax Recruitment 2026 Apply Online
content_sections.text: Candidates interested in Income Tax Recruitment 2026 Online Apply can use the official Income Tax Delhi Sports Recruitment Portal. The application deadline is 10 November 2026 at 11:59 PM . Official Apply Online Link: Income Tax Delhi Sports Quota Recruitment 2026 The portal provides registration, email verification, application submission and document-upload facilities for the advertised sports-quota posts.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for Income Tax Sports Quota Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit sportsrecruitment.incometaxdelhi.gov.in . Read the detailed Sports Quota Recruitment 2026 notification. Register with your personal details and email address. Verify the email address using the OTP sent by the portal. Create a secure password and log in. Select the eligible Tax Assistant, Stenographer Grade II or MTS post. Complete the required sections of the online application form. Enter your educational and sports achievement details accurately. Upload the required documents in the prescribed format. Review the application and submit it before the deadline. Save a copy of the submitted application for future reference. Important: Applications are accepted online only. No physical copy of the application is required to be sent to the Income Tax Department, Delhi.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for Income Tax Sports Quota Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Class 10 Certificate or Other Accepted Date of Birth Proof Aadhaar Card Educational Qualification Certificates and Mark Sheets Prescribed Sports Achievement Certificates Category Certificate, if applicable Recent Photograph and Signature, as required by the portal No Objection Certificate, if applicable Other Documents Prescribed in the Notification Candidates must keep original documents ready for verification whenever required by the department.
